semantic_contract.task_statement: Find the contiguous subarray with the maximum sum (Kadane's Algorithm).

result.canonical_semantics: Maximum contiguous-subarray sum; identifying the achieving subarray/range is part of the task.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite retains the three previously frozen seeded Kadane cases as core behavioural evidence. Singleton and all-negative valid-domain cases are retained as provisional pre-freeze validation cases after the RC9 baseline regression and do not affect calibration or experimental core scores. Empty input remains a separate semantic-boundary probe.
coverage_basis: Core scoring is based on the 3 previously frozen seeded Common Test cases. Singleton and all-negative edge cases are retained in PRE_FREEZE_VALIDATION and are excluded from core scoring until explicitly baseline-validated. Semantic-boundary probes remain separately descriptive.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy only from CORE_BEHAVIOURAL cases. PRE_FREEZE_VALIDATION cases are candidate valid-domain expansions retained for baseline validation and must not affect calibration or experimental core scoring. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive out-of-domain evidence.
coverage_limitations: Singleton and all-negative arrays are valid-domain candidates but remain provisional until the established baseline validates their invocation/observation semantics.
The empty array is outside NON_EMPTY_ARRAY[NUMBER] and is reported separately through semantic-boundary variance.
